messages:
alex: Hey — trying to pin the EU service-overview dashboard into the api-oncall workspace but I get 403 when opening this link: https://grafana.redwood.cloud/d/abcd123/service-overview?orgId=1

mira: That link looks right. 403 usually RBAC. Do you have the `observability-viewer` role on the org or the `team:oncall-api` membership? @james can grant the group if needed.

james: I can add `team:oncall-api` to `observability-viewer`. Want me to do it now? If so I'll add and post audit ID.

alex: please do — blocking a runbook edit for tonight's EU deploy.

james: done — added `team:oncall-api` to `observability-viewer`. audit id: AUDIT-2026-03-17-492. Try again in ~30s.

alex: still 403, panel error shows: "No datasource permission for Loki" when the logs tile loads.

sre-oncall: datasource perms are separate from org roles. james, can you check `loki-logs-eu` datasource ACLs?

james: checking... yep, `loki-logs-eu` had only `ops:read`. I added `team:oncall-api` as `dataSourceViewer` on that datasource. It may take a minute to propagate.

alex: ok i can see panels now :tada: Logs and latency tiles render. Thanks.

alex: can someone with workspace pin perms pin the dashboard to api-oncall? I don't have the pin button.

mira: pinned to the workspace and added a shortlink: https://rwd.io/g/EOvZu — also added a note in the workspace about the runbook change.

alex: perfect, leaving a runbook comment about which tiles to check during the deploy.

devex-bot: Reminder: recurring pins should go through the pin-policy so they survive workspace reorganizations — file at https://go.redwood/pin-policy.

mira: FYI ops runbook change request filed: https://go.redwood/runbooks/116 — cc @oncall
note: Short, practical thread about Grafana access + datasource RBAC + pinning to a workspace. Includes audit ID and shortlink.
